# quick brute-force cross-check of fingerprint over repeated/concatenated/sliced nodes
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
from modules.byte_program import literal, concat, repeat, cut, fingerprint, size

def fp(data):
    n = len(data)
    h = 0
    for i, b in enumerate(data):
        h = (h + (b + 1) * pow(257, n - 1 - i, 1 << 64)) % (1 << 64)
    return {'n': n, 'h': format(h, '016x')}

import random
random.seed(1)
for trial in range(300):
    a = literal(bytes(random.randrange(256) for _ in range(random.randrange(0, 8))))
    b = literal(bytes(random.randrange(256) for _ in range(random.randrange(0, 8))))
    node = concat(repeat(a, random.randrange(0, 5)), repeat(b, random.randrange(0, 5)))
    node = concat(node, repeat(concat(a, b), random.randrange(0, 4)))
    raw = (a.data * 0)  # placeholder
    expected = (a.data * node.count) if False else None
    # build expected bytes manually
    def materialize(n):
        from modules.byte_program import Rep, Cat, Lit
        if isinstance(n, Lit): return n.data
        if isinstance(n, Cat): return b''.join(materialize(p) for p in n.parts)
        if isinstance(n, Rep): return materialize(n.unit) * n.count
    exp = materialize(node)
    assert size(node) == len(exp)
    assert fingerprint(node) == fp(exp), (trial, fingerprint(node), fp(exp))
    for _ in range(4):
        lo = random.randrange(0, len(exp) + 1)
        hi = random.randrange(lo, len(exp) + 1)
        sub = cut(node, lo, hi)
        assert materialize(sub) == exp[lo:hi], (trial, lo, hi)
        assert fingerprint(sub) == fp(exp[lo:hi]), (trial, lo, hi)
print('fingerprint cross-check OK')
